blocks.text: Jpark Island Resort & Waterpark Mactan Cebu held the inaugural Jpark Island Mactan International Marathon (JMIM) on October 11, 2026, drawing more than 2,000 runners for an event that combined athletic competition, community participation, and sports tourism. Powered by Bohol International Marathon (BIM), the event featured four race categories: 42K, 21K, 10K, and 5K. The partnership aimed to deliver a world-class racing experience for local and international participants while introducing a new sporting event to Mactan’s growing calendar of activities.
